```{r}
data <- read.csv("NBA_final (1).csv")
#summary(data)
data$Play <- as.factor(data$Play)
data <- data[complete.cases(data[, c(8,9,10,21,26,27,28,29,30,31,32,33,34,45)]), ]
dim(data)
```




```{r}
#log transformation on the response cause the data is right skewed
data$lnSalary <- log(data$Salary)
```




```{R}
#The final model without transformation.
final_model <- lm(lnSalary ~ G + GS + PTS + TRB + TOV + BLK + 
    mean_views + Play + mean_views:Play, data = data)

summary(final_model)
e_hatf <- resid(final_model)
y_hatf <- fitted(final_model)



```
```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}
par(mfrow=c(4,3))
plot(data$lnSalary ~ y_hatf, ylab="lnSalary", xlab="Fitted")
plot(e_hatf ~ y_hatf, ylab="Residuals", xlab="Fitted")
```


```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
png("pairs_plot.png", width = 800, height = 800, res = 100)
pairs(data[, c("G","GS","TRB","AST","BLK","PTS","mean_views")])
dev.off()
```


```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}
par(mfrow = c(4, 3))

for(i in c("G","GS","TRB","TOV","BLK","PTS","mean_views")){
plot(e_hatf ~ data[,i], ylab="Residuals", xlab= i)
}
```

```{r}
#apply box-cox on predictors(TRB, AST, BLK, PTS, mean_views) to fix the constant variance issues
#install.packages("car")
#library(car)
#summary(powerTransform(cbind(data[,c('TRB','TOV','BLK', 'PTS', 'mean_views')] + 1)))

#apply transfromations on each variable based on results above
data$bcTRB <- bcPower(data$TRB + 1, 0) #log
data$bcTOV <- bcPower(data$TOV + 1, -1/2)
data$bcBLK <- bcPower(data$BLK + 1, -2) 
data$bcPTS <- bcPower(data$PTS + 1, 0) 
data$bcViews <- bcPower(data$mean_views, 0)
```


```{R}
#THE FINAL MODEL WITH TRANSFORMED PREDICTORS
final_model2 <- lm(lnSalary ~ G + GS + bcPTS + bcTRB + bcTOV + bcBLK + 
                      bcViews + Play + bcViews:Play, data = data)

summary(final_model2)
e_hatf2 <- resid(final_model2)
y_hatf2 <- fitted(final_model2)

extractAIC(final_model2, k=2)[2]

vif(final_model2)
```

```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}
par(mfrow=c(4,3))
plot(data$lnSalary ~ y_hatf, ylab="lnSalary", xlab="Fitted")
plot(e_hatf ~ y_hatf, ylab="Residuals", xlab="Fitted")
```


```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
png("pairs_plot.png", width = 800, height = 800, res = 100)
pairs(data[, c("G","GS","bcTRB","bcTOV","bcBLK","bcPTS","bcViews")])
dev.off()
```


```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}
par(mfrow = c(4, 3))

for(i in c("G","GS","bcTRB","bcTOV","bcBLK","bcPTS","bcViews")){
plot(e_hatf ~ data[,i], ylab="Residuals", xlab= i)
}
```

```{r, echo=F, fig.width=3, fig.height=5}
qqnorm(e_hatf2)
qqline(e_hatf2)
```
